RATHA PRIEST SLAYER
CR 1/2

Elan psychic warrior (ratha priest slayer) 1

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+1 Dex, +2 natural, +4 inertial armor); +4 vs. rays hp 11 (1d10+1)
Fort +2, Ref +1, Will +2; –2 vs. sonic

Melee greataxe +2 (1d12+3/x3)
Psychic Warrior Powers Known (ML 1st; concentration +3); 1 pp

1st—inertial armor
0th (at will)—distract P (DC 12)

P path power; Path assassin

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 12, Con 13, Int 10, Wis 15, Cha 10
Base Atk +0; CMB +2; CMD 13

Languages Common
SQ repletion
Gear power stone of empty mind, heavy cloak, healer’s kit, 50-foot rope (spider silk)
